verdict.rationale: Bolt's docs say you can invite collaborators to a project at any stage and assign them roles. Its multiplayer mode lets collaborators prompt and edit in the same project at the same time, but only when the project's visibility is set to public. missing for 10: real-time multiplayer on private projects (it requires public visibility), documentation of a team-level shared workspace beyond per-project invites, independent or hands-on corroboration of collaboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my team can work on the same project together in a shared workspace

citations.quote: Bolt lets you invite collaborators to your project at any stage, whether you're still building, ready for review, or preparing to make your site public.
collaborators can work together in multiplayer mode. This lets you prompt and edit in the same project at the same time.
When your project visibility is set to public, collaborators can work together in multiplayer mode.
Assign collaborators a role that matches the level of access you want them to have.
